opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution, and not eligible for government tuition fee funding. Must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, or hold Limited Leave to Remain, or be an asylum seeker.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering the cost of tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for undergraduate students from low-income households in Scotland who are ineligible for government tuition fee support. Application portal open from 1 June 2026 to 5pm 1 December 2026 for academic year 2026-27.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus an additional living-cost bursary of £1,200.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, have been accepted onto the MSc Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (full-time or part-time) at the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh/University of Edinburgh, and have not already obtained a postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: Scholarship covering full tuition fees and a £1,200 living-cost bursary for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants, jointly delivered by the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh and the University of Edinburgh, aimed at widening participation in postgraduate plant science study.
